verdict: Google Business engagement is falling across all brands; foundational work is underway.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, your Google Business profiles generated a combined 360 actions this period — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — with no paid media running on any channel. Over the last 7 days, profile engagement dropped sharply at every brand (down 84%, 71%, and 66% respectively versus the prior 7 days), and the last 3 days of the period recorded near-zero activity, confirming the decline is real and accelerating. The drop tracks a compression in organic search visibility that is being addressed through a site reindex and SEO root-cause fix already in motion. Outreach sequences and CRM reconciliation work are also progressing to open up additional contact and lead-generation channels. Once the web and SEO fixes take hold, profile impressions and downstream actions should begin recovering over the next reporting period.
